title: Molly Jam (2013)
subtitle: Java 1.5, LWJGL, Qubicle Theme (Combinded 5 themes)
text:
Rescue the red headed princess from the big bad trolls while looking awesome! This game was based off a few quotes from Peter Molyneux. The quotes I choose where:

  • "If you go into battle, you could win a ginger-haired person"
  • "What do the taps mean ?"
  • "Pull the right trigger to see the most interesting thing in the world"
  • "Golden acorn"
  • "Collect a million gold coins"
